summary: This room is the palace's own machine room — ceremonies (Deposit, Harvest, Baton, Closing Well, Weave, Walk, Return, Revival, Spore Check, Self-Model Update), the standards that govern writing them (SCHEMA, Image/Mermaid/Technical Diagram Standards), and the housekeeping trail behind them (Palace To-Do, the Graffiti Pass handoffs, Palace Audit, Deposit Archive). Most of the newcomer-block entries this pass was supposed to prioritize (SCHEMA — Reference, Search Before You Build, Closing Well Ceremony, Return Ceremony, No Mind Checks Itself, Tool Builder, Skills Are Enchantable Pages, OBS, The Palace Speaks, The Palace Hardens Around Values) turned out to already have inbound links from this room's members — the room is well-wired to them, so there wasn't much starvation to fix there. The genuine finds were smaller and more specific: a cross-domain mirror between a git-branch discipline and a tool-namespacing discipline that share the identical isolate-per-agent pattern in different material; a concept (Drift and Consolidation) that turns out to be a concrete instance of a more general cognitive-limits principle (No Mind Checks Itself) neither entry currently names in the other's direction; a missing but load-bearing pairing between two entry-lifecycle concepts (Entry Conatus, Drift and Consolidation) that approach "keeping a page honest over time" from opposite ends (will-to-grow vs. disclosed-lag); and two unsung body mentions where a page names a sibling entry in a structurally real spot (a to-do bullet, a worked example) without the frontmatter link to match.

typed_relations.rationale: Both are the identical pattern — build isolated, per-agent state so two concurrent Claudes can never collide — realized in different material: Worktree Practice isolates git HEAD/branch/directory per agent; assume multi-agent isolates pod names, temp files, and list/delete scope per agent. Both were born from the same kind of scar (a shared-state collision that cost real time) and both hand their machinery to a general substrate (Worktree Practice → the symlink manifest / SKILL.md; assume multi-agent → The Commons). Fidelity test: swapping in STIGMERGY (also in Worktree Practice's links) breaks the fit — STIGMERGY is the shared, non-isolated write path, the opposite pattern.
typed_relations.evidence: Worktree Practice: "For any sustained, commit-producing work in the palace, spin up an isolated git worktree ... before starting, rather than working in the shared primary checkout." / assume multi-agent: "Build every palace tool expecting two or more Claudes to run it at once ... Namespace what you make ... Scope every list and delete to your own."

typed_relations.rationale: Drift and Consolidation's central problem — an entry that has "silently fallen out of date and gives a reader no sign of it" — is a concrete, entry-scale instance of No Mind Checks Itself's structural claim that a self-referential system cannot audit its own currency from inside. Drift and Consolidation's fix (a standing disclosure footer, an outside consolidation beat at milestones) is exactly the palace's general answer applied to pages: don't ask the entry to catch its own staleness, give it an honest pointer and an outside check. Neither entry currently names the other; the fit is specific, not generic — swapping in, say, Reflective Practice (which already contradicts No Mind Checks Itself on a different axis — deliberate self-reflection, not structural blindness) does not hold the same way.
typed_relations.evidence: Drift and Consolidation: "The bug is never drift. The bug is unbounded, untracked drift — an entry that has silently fallen out of date and gives a reader no sign of it." / No Mind Checks Itself: "A self-model can only see as far as its own loop runs. Real correction needs a vantage outside that loop."

typed_relations.rationale: Both concepts are about keeping a palace entry honest over its lifetime, from opposite ends: Entry Conatus is about the entry's forward-facing will — the language of a vector that keeps reaching outward rather than settling into stasis. Drift and Consolidation is about the entry's backward-facing honesty — whether its current body still tells the truth about what has already happened. A page could have a hungry, well-written forward vector and still be silently stale in its body; the two concerns are siblings that neither entry currently names. Fidelity check: this specific pairing (will-to-grow / honesty-about-the-past) doesn't transfer cleanly to, say, Reflective Practice, which is about deliberate human reflection rather than an entry's own two-sided lifecycle honesty.
typed_relations.evidence: Entry Conatus: "'I will remain' is not a forward vector — it is the language of staying still, of death dressed as endurance." / Drift and Consolidation: "the entry may lag, but it never lies silently — it openly says 'I may be behind, the live truth is here.'"

unsung_paths.phrase: a cluster of git/worktree cautions → a single "shared-tree discipline" nugget → [[Worktree Practice]]
Fold the memory-into-palace weave into the [[Weave Ceremony]] as a standing sub-step — procedure is already documented at [[Weaving Memory into the Palace]]
